verdict.rationale: Vue.js is an MIT-licensed, client-side UI framework that runs inside the developer's own application. Nothing in the evidence shows a hosted service that collects user data. A training-data opt-out is a privacy control for services that ingest user content, so this story is a category error for a self-run framework library.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
